notes.text:
This update for openexr fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-88384: NULL pointer dereference in the C++ attribute parsing path when a specially crafted EXR file
  containing an unknown-type attribute with dataSize set to zero is processed (bsc#1282700).

notes.text: OpenEXR 3.4.14 contains a NULL Pointer Dereference in the C++ attribute parsing path. A specially crafted EXR file containing an unknown-type attribute with dataSize set to zero causes the parser to create an opaque attribute with a NULL packed_data pointer. The OpaqueAttribute constructor passes the NULL pointer to memcpy() without validating the zero-size condition, resulting in undefined behavior and process termination, leading to denial of service.
